example.title: Glen Gardner Bridge (Mill Street Bridge / Spruce Run Bridge), Mill Street over Spruce Run

brief: Composite cast- and wrought-iron Pratt pony truss of 1870, originally a railway span, reused on a village mill street: cast-iron posts shaped like small classical columns with moulded capitals and bases, tall cast-iron newel posts at the four corners, wrought-iron rod diagonals and flat bar chords, and a latticed rail between the posts, all painted green. One lane, on stone abutments over a rocky, tree-shaded creek beside frame houses; a small weight-limit sign on the corner post. (Span estimated at about 50 ft from photos.)

names.plate: cast name plate: MILL STREET BRIDGE · 1870 · W. COWDEN, FABRICATOR
